A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 25-page FusionRoute paper, including Appendices A–C. Although v3 clips Figure 4 at the page boundary, its embedded chart and extracted caption match v4, permitting reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 5–6 report original benchmark experiments, GPT-4o evaluations, and ablations on Llama-3 and Gemma-2 models (Tables 1–2; Figures 3–4).

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results and ablations, alongside the routing examples in Appendix C.2.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same expert selection, complementary logit addition, SFT, CDPO, and mixed training procedures.

E1.justification: Training with PerfectBlend and OpenHermes and evaluation on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, IFEval, and held-out PerfectBlend remain unchanged. No task or scenario coverage changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparator memberships, including expert/base models, Sequence Selection, Collab, DARE, TaskArithmetic, the fine-tuned model, and the routing/CDPO ablation variants.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.2 and Appendix C.1 retain the same model configurations, training budgets, splits, greedy decoding, sample counts, generation limits, and GPT-4o evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Section 6’s complementary-logit and CDPO ablations and Appendix C.2’s routing case studies are unchanged. Figure 4 is relocated, without adding or revising an analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2, Figures 3–4, and Appendix C.2 retain the same results. For example, Table 1’s FusionRoute average accuracies remain 0.566 for Llama-3 and 0.426 for Gemma-2; Figure 4’s embedded chart is identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, bounds, Theorem 4.3, its Appendix A proof, and Appendix B’s theoretical comparison with Collab are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about expert-only routing limitations, complementary generation, and FusionRoute’s empirical effectiveness and efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of complementary logits, CDPO, model scale, and routing behavior remain unchanged, as do the qualifications concerning coverage assumptions in Section 4.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, checkpoint identifiers, generation details, and the GPT-4o evaluation prompt in Section 5.1 and Appendix C.1 are unchanged. The documented project and data access information also remains the same.

R1.justification: Section 7’s related-work discussion and the reference list are unchanged after matching reflowed passages. No cited works or substantive research-positioning statements are added or removed.

P1.justification: Front-page date/version information is updated, and paragraph flow around Section 6.2 adjusts. Body wording and section order otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 4 moves from the bottom of page 13 in v3, where labels are clipped and its caption falls outside the page, to page 14 in v4, where both are fully visible. Surrounding text on pages 13–15 reflows; the chart content and other visuals are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 fixes Figure 4’s overflow and makes its full chart and caption readable on page 14. This resolves a concrete presentation defect affecting existing ablation evidence, while the scientific content and appendices remain unchanged.
